name: What is the process for hiring City Dweller, LLC for access improvements?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for hiring City Dweller, LLC for access improvements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we conduct an on-site assessment to evaluate existing conditions and take measurements. Following this, we provide a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, timeline, and cost. Once approved, we handle all necessary permits and commence work, keeping you informed throughout the construction phase until project completion and final walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, on-site assessment, detailed proposal, permit handling, construction, and final walkthrough.
